correctness.rationale: Every projective basis lies in one transitive PGL orbit; an orientation-reversing facet stabilizer forces coefficient a=-a; every independent codimension-one face extends in exactly q^(r-1) facets; no higher boundaries exist. Thus invariant homology is A[2] for even q and zero for odd q. Finite full-face enumerations over q=2,3,4 corroborate the incidence, including GF(4) extension-field arithmetic; they are not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural uniform classification of an entire group-fixed homology functor for all ranks, prime-power fields and abelian coefficients. It identifies the exact characteristic-two onset of a canonical nonliftable symmetry-fixed top class, contrasting ordinary integral/rational zero invariants. The statement is not merely a new small parameter or a numerical increment.
